publisher_once_one_worker.measured_or_projected: One measured GPU compile, each artifact D2H and replica0 H2D once. Conservative if publisher and worker share device and could retain state directly.

publisher_once_four_copies.measured_or_projected: One actual GPU compile then four measured serialized host copies; no network or concurrent replica claim

four_independent_preparers.measured_or_projected: Four times measured resident shared compute, calibration once; method input/bank/model distribution to independent workers is not measured and must be added. Not an alternative complete deployment winner.

shared_preparation.scope: Primary one A40 worker: retained offline calibration including causal source/teacher generation and one origin, fresh compile once, then measured D2H and first H2D copy per shared artifact. Historical calibration loads are not counted twice. Four workers are a separate sensitivity.
shared_preparation.missing: Final relay checkpoint serialization and artifact/network persistence are not separately measured; add their nonnegative fixed delta_S if required. Initial V2 cache and foundation training are common outside the window.
shared_preparation.distribution_scope: Primary uses D2H+replica0 H2D, conservatively retaining a host round trip even when publisher and serving share the GPU. The separate four-copy scenario uses all four actually sequential copies, never concurrent cluster wall time.

native_model_references.scope: Measured native-only Medium/Large/Max V2/V5 operator references. Large/Max correction, full service traces and end-to-end method comparisons are absent.
native_model_references.batch8_scope: Native probe B8 repeats one history; not actual eight-user scheduling. Not substituted into corrected session totals.

measured_execution_configuration.purpose: Same fixed32 real sessions and eager/graph interleaving, extending only full-N1024 graphs to every actual B1..8 and powers-of-two append width. Short histories stay eager; expected226 encountered graph shapes, capture/workspace charged separately.
measured_execution_configuration.reference_scope: Same fair-native and fused-code-maintenance eager batch path; graph is the sole numerical execution change.

relay.scope: Median of actual one-set setup samples, counted once per method. Includes static allocation, three warm compute calls and capture, not the full warm trace. Stable kernel-cache setup; pure first JIT is not separately measured.

rebuild.scope: Median of actual one-set setup samples, counted once per method. Includes static allocation, three warm compute calls and capture, not the full warm trace. Stable kernel-cache setup; pure first JIT is not separately measured.

relay.scope: Main fixed preparation retains the actually measured graph set. Missing population shapes add unknown delta_S_graph and workspace; listed means per measured shape are diagnostics, not measured preparation or reliable bounds. Graph sets depend on model/adapter release and operation/B/W/has-code, not UID count. Positive code prefixes share one dynamic-count graph. No cold preparation is assigned to unsupported eager shapes.

rebuild.scope: Main fixed preparation retains the actually measured graph set. Missing population shapes add unknown delta_S_graph and workspace; listed means per measured shape are diagnostics, not measured preparation or reliable bounds. Graph sets depend on model/adapter release and operation/B/W/has-code, not UID count. Positive code prefixes share one dynamic-count graph. No cold preparation is assigned to unsupported eager shapes.

graph_preparation_flops_sensitivity.scope: Three executed warm model calls per graph entry, with its recorded initial code prefix. The fourth Python call records the graph without executing device kernels; the following replay belongs to normal service. Legacy initial_prepare_model_calls=4 is interpreted using the audited implementation, not rewritten. Mathematical effective operations only; copies/capture metadata are not FLOPs, tile padding and TF32x3 machine instructions excluded. Repeated benchmark graph sets are not summed.

host_paging_projection.scope: Real 30k frontier paging byte counts, real final V5 state measurements. Complete-page phases scale by requested bytes for field subsets/unseen N; empirical observations are not bounds. Round-trip orchestration gap split equally between directions. GPU allocation is already inside H2D; pinned staging allocation is once, not each visit.
host_paging_projection.placement: Primary capacity-feasible conditional policy pages at each actual operation boundary (batch<=8): append writes native+codes, conversions only codes, score read-only, rebuild generates native without loading obsolete KV. No overlap. Existing warm API packing retained, not removed as a speculative optimization. Miss fraction uniformly scales operation visits; not observed cache behavior.
host_paging_projection.missing: First creation of host backing for the whole population is not a measured deployment cost. Existing native backing belongs to common B; allocating the extra code backing requires an additional nonnegative delta_backing. One cold 32-user allocation is retained as evidence, not extrapolated as a proven bandwidth.

unimplemented_request_local_paging_poten.scope: Real 30k frontier paging byte counts, real final V5 state measurements. Complete-page phases scale by requested bytes for field subsets/unseen N; empirical observations are not bounds. Round-trip orchestration gap split equally between directions. GPU allocation is already inside H2D; pinned staging allocation is once, not each visit.
unimplemented_request_local_paging_poten.placement: Unimplemented request-local optimization only: page retained across append/prepare/score. Actual frontier advances the whole wave before scoring and cannot in general retain that wave on GPU. These smaller bytes must not be used as primary capacity-feasible deployment results.
unimplemented_request_local_paging_poten.missing: First creation of host backing for the whole population is not a measured deployment cost. Existing native backing belongs to common B; allocating the extra code backing requires an additional nonnegative delta_backing. One cold 32-user allocation is retained as evidence, not extrapolated as a proven bandwidth.

compilation_boundary.stable_cycle: The main S+service prediction assumes required backend kernels already compiled for the unchanged model/kernel geometry. Parameter-only publication does not by itself require compilation.
compilation_boundary.scope: Warmup intervals execute full reference trajectories and may contain first compilation, allocations, caches and normal model work. They are not isolated compilation costs and are not added once per model release.
compilation_boundary.cold_start: Add a separately reported nonnegative delta_JIT to both affected method setups if the required kernel cache is unavailable. Pure compile seconds are not separated; stable-cycle estimates do not establish cold-start break-even.
compilation_boundary.known_failure: The earlier projection32 attempt1 was interrupted during shape-specialization warmup (about291s without completion). This is retained engineering evidence, not a warm service coefficient or a finite measured cold compile budget.

arithmetic_views.preparation: single publisher/one serving worker, shared compile once; calibration64fit and fixed origin unchanged

reader_padding.geometry: M>4: BM16,BN64,BR16,BD32; key projection and value decode once per query tile, score/latent code dots only ceil(maxcoded/64) blocks. Count all six layers/heads and actual batch/query geometry. M<=4 uses vector products/reductions with rank8 masks; shown separately, no tensor-dot claim.
reader_padding.boundary: Only method-specific logical dots added to the mathematical ledger. Does not count TF32x3 instruction expansion, scalar/reduction padding, gate GEMM backend padding, common native attention/model padding, or machine instruction FLOPs.

arithmetic_views.boundary: Tile sensitivity adds known method dot padding to the mathematical numerator and keeps the mathematical Rebuild denominator. It is not complete executed hardware FLOPs. Logical coalescing is included before tile padding; no double counting.

distinctions: Actual phase/body wall times include CPU work, launch gaps and synchronization; neither they nor CUDA event spans are GPU busy seconds.
Pack_h2d combines CPU packing, device gathers and small input copies; it cannot be relabelled as pure CPU or transfer time. All three phase intervals are sequential and non-overlapping.
30k population counts are exact, hardware time coefficients are sampled and shape-bucket fallbacks are explicit empirical projections.

With frontier input, deployment batch occupancy and max-coded prefix are exactly replayed on CPU. Unmeasured hardware shapes use flagged same-batch nearby pools. Saturated frontier scheduling does not establish an arrival-time batch or queue policy.

30k final K/V+code do not fit four48GB cards. Host paging sensitivity adds measured directional transfer/packing coefficients to exact byte counts; this is not integrated backing-tier service or an observed miss rate.
S plus population service is additive API-work seconds under serialized execution assumptions, not loaded multi-GPU makespan or p99.
Foundation training, initial V2 cache construction and common foundation deployment add the same B to both sides; absolute savings unchanged, percentages diluted.
Population expansion holds Medium model, catalogue, calibration users, three-release horizon and activity distribution fixed; 79681/200000 rows are not Large/Max workload evidence.
